built: A token in a case's text is a number that passes its check, built when the test runs so the repository never holds one. {luhn:DIGITS}: DIGITS as written with the Luhn check digit after them. {iban:CC:BBAN}: CC, the two ISO 13616 check digits (98 minus BBAN + CC + "00" mod 97, letters as A=10 … Z=35), then BBAN. {iban4:CC:BBAN}: the same, in groups of four with a space between. {fours:DIGITS}: DIGITS in groups of four with a space between. Answers name the same tokens.
rule: PaymentCardNumbers.lastFour(of:): only the last four digits of what was typed or read
shape: value: text typed or read. lastFour: its last four ASCII digits, or null when it has fewer.
